v0.5.2.description:
The Bazaar for Archipelago. Download **`bazaar.apworld`** below and follow the
[setup guide in the README](https://github.com/sfleming4587/BazaarArchipelago#setting-it-up-on-a-new-pc-windows).

**Needs** Archipelago 0.6.4 or newer and The Bazaar on Steam (Windows). The client only reads the game's own log
file - it doesn't mod the game.

### What's in it
- **Checks per hero, per day:** reach the day, win the day's PvP fight, beat the hour-3 monster (one check per
  rarity: Silver from day 1, Gold from day 2, Diamond from day 3, Legendary from day 6), plus a 10-win check.
  98 checks per hero with the default options.
- **Goal:** 10 wins with 3 different heroes (1-8, up to the heroes you have).
- **Unlocks:** heroes, individual cards, Legendary Items, Expedition Tickets, optional legacy card packs.
  20 Bronze starter cards per hero are never locked.
- **Fair play enforced:** no checks while you hold a locked card, play a locked hero, or owe a DeathLink.
  Selling the card lifts the block automatically.
- **Warnings over the game:** which locked cards a merchant or item choice could offer, unlock pop-ups,
  PvP "did you win?" prompt.
- **DeathLink** on a lost run (and on concede, default on). Optional **Sell Traps**.
- **Keeps working after game patches** - it warns instead of breaking.
- **Universal Tracker** support, option presets (Casual / Standard / Hardcore).

### Known limits
- Card pictures in the Shop Guide need Pillow, which the Archipelago Windows installer doesn't include, so the
  Shop Guide stays off there; the locked-card warning at the top of the screen still works.
- The game's log doesn't say who won a PvP fight, so the client asks you.
- Items the game creates by itself (from another item, a Shovel, a transformation) aren't tracked and are always
  allowed.
v0.5.2.title: The Bazaar for Archipelago v0.5.2

v0.6.0.description:
## Fixes
- **A new seed no longer inherits an old seed's run.** The client's saved run wasn't tied to the seed, so an old run could send a check in a new seed (e.g. a free "The Dragons - Reach Day 1" with The Dragons locked).
- **A run that's already outside logic when the client starts must be conceded.** If you're playing a locked hero or holding locked cards when the client starts, selling doesn't clear it; only conceding does, and conceding it never sends a DeathLink.

## Overlay
- **Stays beside the board.** It never covers the board or blocks your clicks, and no two overlay windows overlap. Alerts are top left, a shop's locked cards are right under them, the Shop Guide is on the right, and pop-ups are bottom right, above the settings gear.
- **Follows the game window**, so it fits any resolution (1080p, 1440p, 4K, ultrawide), fullscreen or windowed, on any monitor. Text scales with the window.
- **Only shows while The Bazaar is the active window** and never takes the keyboard focus from the game.
- **See-through**, so item tooltips behind it stay readable. Clicks go straight through the locked-card list and the pop-ups.
- **Colour shows urgency:** red = checks blocked or a DeathLink, amber = something to act on, dark = info, green = all good.
- **Long shop lists** use as many columns as fit and shrink the text (never below a readable size) instead of overflowing.
- **Redraws only what changed**, so it doesn't flicker.

## New
- **Hero reminder** on the hero-select screen: which heroes you may play, and a red warning if you pick a locked one.
- **Progress line** during a run: hero, day, next check and goal.
- **CHECK NOT SENT** pop-up the moment a check is blocked, naming the check.
- **Green tick** when a shop has nothing locked for you.

Download `bazaar.apworld` below and put it in Archipelago's `custom_worlds` folder (see the README).
v0.6.0.title: The Bazaar for Archipelago v0.6.0

v0.6.1.description:
## Overlay
- **Locked-card list is easy to read again:** its text is solid, and only the background is see-through (item tooltips behind it still show).
- **Hide list / Show list** button in the alert box (top left) hides the locked-card list until you show it again.
- The **Pictures** (Shop Guide) and **Hide list** buttons sit on the status line instead of taking a row of their own.

## Pop-ups
- **SENT: item to player** when one of your checks finds an item for someone else.
- **FOUND: item** when one of your checks finds filler for you (your own unlocks already show UNLOCKED).

Everything from v0.6.0 is included. Download `bazaar.apworld` below and put it in Archipelago's `custom_worlds` folder (see the README).
v0.6.1.title: The Bazaar for Archipelago v0.6.1

v0.6.2.description:
## New
- **SELL IT NOW** pop-up (red, bottom right) the moment you buy or get a locked card.
- **Locked only** mode in the Shop Guide: just the pictures of the cards you may not buy, so you learn to recognise them. **Show all** brings the rest back; your choice is remembered.

Everything from v0.6.1 is included. Download `bazaar.apworld` below and put it in Archipelago's `custom_worlds` folder (see the README).
v0.6.2.title: The Bazaar for Archipelago v0.6.2

v0.6.3.description:
## Fixes
- **Python 3.11:** the overlay failed to load on Python 3.11 in v0.6.0–v0.6.2 (it used syntax that needs Python 3.12). Fixed.

## Changes
- **The Archipelago client window shows only item history** (what your checks found, sent and received) and replies to your commands. Everything about your run (shop lists, blocks, sells, run start and end) is in the overlay and still written to the client's log file.

Everything from v0.6.2 is included. Download `bazaar.apworld` below and put it in Archipelago's `custom_worlds` folder (see the README).
v0.6.3.title: The Bazaar for Archipelago v0.6.3

v0.7.0.description:
## New
- **Tracker**: press **Tracker** on the top-left box (or type `/tracker`). A card per hero with four squares - reach day N, PvP win on day N, monster checks (a row per day, Bronze to Legendary), 10 wins. Green = in logic, yellow = out of logic, red = hero locked, grey = done. Hover a square for its checks; click to keep the list open. Heroes not in your seed are dimmed. It's a normal window you can move anywhere.
- **PvP wins are counted automatically** - no more Won/Lost question.
- **Hero-select screen**: the top-left box lists the heroes you may play, with checks done / checks in logic, and warns if you pick a locked hero.
- **Owned DLC heroes are on/off switches** (`own_mak`, `own_stelle`, `own_jules`, `own_karnok`, `own_the_dragons`) instead of typed names. Older YAMLs with `owned_dlc_heroes` still work.
- **Every item choice warns about locked cards** - 379 events and options now (was 30), including Hidden Lake's options, Make a Wish and cards from other heroes' pools. Choices that could be almost anything say so instead of listing hundreds of names.
- **Pop-ups name the other player** for everything received, sent or found; **SELL IT NOW** when you get a locked card.
- **Shop Guide**: cards at their in-game size (1/2/3 slots, cropped, not stretched), a **Locked only** view, and it's a real window you can move anywhere.

## Changes
- **DeathLink and DeathLink on concede are off by default.**
- The Archipelago client window shows only item history and the replies to your commands; everything about your run is on the overlay.
- The top-left status line shows your hero, day and goal (use the tracker for what's left).

## Fixes
- **The overlay can't end up off screen**: every overlay window is kept on the monitor the game is on, at any resolution, windowed or fullscreen, and a nonsensical game position is ignored.
- Shop Guide: no longer stops following its spot or disappears behind the game; no longer cuts off the hero name.
- Card pictures no longer break if another program part uses Tk.

Everything from v0.6.3 is included. Download `bazaar.apworld` below and install it (see the README).
v0.7.0.title: The Bazaar for Archipelago v0.7.0

v0.7.1.description:
## What's new

**The Shop Guide works on normal Archipelago installs.** Before, it quietly never opened unless Archipelago ran from source. Card pictures now load without any extra libraries. Cards newer than the picture source (all of Karnok and The Dragons, for now) show a "no picture" box at their in-game size with their name under it.

**Play you did offline still counts.** If your wifi drops, or you forget to start the client, just keep playing. When the client reconnects it sends everything you earned in the meantime, even for runs that already ended. Those runs don't send a late DeathLink. It can read back as far as the previous game session.

**Options**
- Max day can be set up to 16 (later days need specific events) and now defaults to 13.
- **Duplicate All Cards** is now labelled as casual mode: the same number of checks, but about half as many locked cards.
- Excluded heroes are simple on/off switches, like the DLC heroes.

**Fixes**
- A new run never inherits an old run's blocks or day, and a run resumed after a game restart keeps its real day.
- Overlay fixes from a full code review: freezes, focus, overlaps and lists that didn't update.
- Two world-generation bugs fixed.

**Docs:** the README, setup guide and developer guide got a friendly rewrite.

Games generated with an older version keep working.
v0.7.1.title: The Bazaar for Archipelago v0.7.1

v0.7.2.description:
## What's new

This one is mostly about options.

**Presets.** Launcher → **Generate Template Options** now writes three ready-made setups to `Players/Templates/Presets`:

| | Casual | Standard | Hardcore |
|---|---|---|---|
| Heroes to win | 1 | 3 | 6 (if you own them) |
| Max day | 12 | 13 | 16 |
| Monster checks up to | Gold | Diamond | Legendary |
| Locked cards | 60% | 80% | 100% |
| Legendary Items / Expedition Tickets copies | 3 / 3 | 2 / 2 | 1 / 1 |
| Legacy card packs | off | off | on |
| Sell Traps | 0 | 3 | 10 (1 day to sell) |
| Lock Bypasses | 10 | 5 | 0 |
| DeathLink | off | off | on |

Standard is simply the defaults.

**Lock Bypasses (new).** The friendly opposite of a Sell Trap. Holding a locked card? The alert says **SELL OR USE BYPASS** with a **Use Bypass** button next to it. Press it and that card is yours for the rest of the run, upgrades included. A bypass is never used by itself, and the top-left box always shows how many you have.

**Pick your own legacy packs.** With Legacy Card Packs on, every pack has its own switch, so you can keep just the ones you like. Packs lock a lot of extra cards, so turning on **Duplicate All Cards (casual)** as well is recommended.

**Copy counts stay as you set them.** Lowering the locked cards percent no longer adds extra copies of Legendary Items, Expedition Tickets or cards you chose in `duplicate_cards`.

**Heads up - new defaults.** If your YAML doesn't set them: monster checks now stop at Diamond, 80% of spare checks hold locked cards, and 3 Sell Traps and 5 Lock Bypasses are in the pool. Set `max_monster_tier: legendary`, `locked_cards_percent: 100`, `sell_traps: 0` and `lock_bypasses: 0` to keep the old behaviour.

Games generated with an older version keep working.
v0.7.2.title: The Bazaar for Archipelago v0.7.2

v0.7.3.description:
## What's new

**Every card has a picture now.** The Shop Guide's pictures come from a new, complete set - Karnok and The Dragons included, no more "no picture" boxes for them. Many thanks to [Bazaar DB](https://bazaardb.gg) for the images!

The pictures come in one small download (about 3 MB) the first time the client starts, and then they're kept on your PC. Offline? You'll see name boxes until the next time you're connected.

Everything else is the same as v0.7.2 - see its notes for the presets, Lock Bypasses and pick-your-own legacy packs. Games generated with an older version keep working.
v0.7.3.title: The Bazaar for Archipelago v0.7.3

v0.7.4.description:
## What's new

**Later days expect more cards.** Logic now climbs after day 10: the new option **Logic: Cards Before The Last Day** (`logic_last_day_cards`) sets how many of a hero's cards logic expects by your last day, and the 10-win check expects that amount too. Casual 12, Standard 28, Hardcore 50.

**Fixes from a full review of the whole project**
- Every allowed option mix now generates. Small seeds (one hero, PvP/monster checks off, a short max day) used to fail every time; logic is now lowered to fit, with a warning.
- **Duplicate All Cards** no longer leaves useless filler: every spare check holds another locked card (with its second copy).
- Reconnecting mid-run no longer re-judges the run: no repeated pop-ups, `/unblock` sticks, and a Lock Bypass never unlocks the days before you used it. A game restart followed by a reconnect keeps your run as it was.
- A Sell Trap that arrives while you're disconnected now gets a fair deadline (from the day you're actually on).
- `/locked The Dragons` and `/logpath` with a normal Windows path work.
- A damaged picture download fixes itself (it's fetched again) instead of stopping pictures for good.
- The overlay: text never smaller than 10 px, the alert box keeps its buttons even with many locked cards held, and the Shop Guide no longer starts over the game's settings gear.
- Option descriptions and guides corrected.

Correction to the v0.7.3 notes: Shop Guide pictures download when the client starts; if you were offline then, they come next time you start it.

**Heads up:** seeds generated with an older version may not work with this client - generate a new one.
v0.7.4.title: The Bazaar for Archipelago v0.7.4

v0.8.0.description:
## What's new

**Padlocks right on the locked cards.** In shops, level-ups, loot, events' item choices and your open stash, every locked card now gets a red padlock on the card itself, exactly where it sits on screen. The client reads which cards are on offer from the game's memory - read-only, nothing outside The Bazaar is ever looked at, and it never touches your input or the game's files. The padlocks follow the game: they wait for cards to flip over, turn see-through while you read a tooltip or drag a card, hide under the Esc menu and while your stash slides, and stay put when you buy the card next to them. If a game patch changes what the reader expects, it switches itself off and tells you, rather than guessing.

**The Shop Guide, reworked.** It now owns the whole left column. The cards on offer right now come first, framed in gold, and it opens any time - not just in a shop - with search, size, rarity and merchant filters. It redraws silently (only what changed), and a card you buy from the offer stays in the list.

**A hero panel on the main menu.** Every hero in your multiworld as a tile: checks done, cards unlocked out of all of theirs, locked heroes dimmed with a padlock. It warns you if the hero you picked is locked - or if Random could roll a locked hero or one not in your multiworld (it reads your Random setting and exclusions). It steps aside whenever one of the game's own screens is open, or the Tracker is over it.

**Sell Traps you won't miss.** A flaming skull marks a Sell Trap, in its pop-up and in the notice. A trap never picks a locked card you're already holding, follows a card that transforms, and turns into a red CHECKS ARE BLOCKED the moment its deadline passes - even if the client was off when it did.

**Also**
- Transformations are allowed: a locked card that transforms stops blocking checks, and what it becomes is yours for the rest of the run.
- A red warning when the client isn't connected to the multiworld.
- The old list of locked cards beside the board is gone - the padlocks say it now.
- Every event in the game is now in the data, ready for merchant and event locks in a later version.

**Heads up:** seeds generated with an older version may not work with this client - generate a new one.
v0.8.0.title: The Bazaar for Archipelago v0.8.0

v0.9.0.description:
## What's new

**Locked merchants and events.** A share of the merchants and events your heroes can meet now get their own unlock item (`locked_encounters_percent`, 25% by default). You can still walk into a locked merchant, but anything you buy there counts as a locked card. Walking into any other locked event blocks checks for the rest of that run - unless you spend a Lock Bypass on it. A few merchants are always open (`starter_merchants`), monsters and level-up rewards are never locked, and if every event on offer is locked, the least rare one is let through. Locked merchants and events get a padlock right on the choice screen.

**Event Rarity Progression.** Diamond merchants and events stay locked until you find the first "Event Rarity Progression"; the second opens up Legendary ones. Copies past those two count as Lock Bypasses. Expeditions are exempt unless you turn `exempt_expeditions` off.

**DeathLinks with personality.** When you lose, everyone else reads a line that fits your hero and how far the run got - by wins, never by day. Vanessa players get thrown overboard, Dooley only beeps, Pygmalien was HUGE... hmm? A run with no wins at all is trash. You also see the line you sent in your own client.

**`/deathlink`.** Turn DeathLink on or off from the client for the session, whatever your YAML says.

**Pictures in pop-ups.** Unlocking a card shows its picture; a pack shows three and "+ N more". Pop-ups now say **FOUND** for anything from your own world and **RECEIVED ... from** with the player's name for anything from someone else, and as many as fit are shown at once.

**Also**
- Card pictures come inside the apworld - the client no longer downloads anything.
- The DEATHLINK notice stays up until that run ends (no more Done button), and comes back if you restart the client mid-run.
- Padlocks show up a little sooner when new cards flip over, and stay solid while you hover an event option.
- The memory reader no longer switches itself off when the game is still loading.
- The menu's hero panel stays out of the way on the win/lose screen.
- No more "card this apworld doesn't track" message for special items like Pelt or Midsworth's Package - they're simply never locked.
- `owned_dlc_heroes` and `excluded_heroes` are gone; use the per-hero on/off switches. Old YAMLs that still set retired options get a warning instead of an error.

**Heads up:** seeds generated with an older version won't work with this client - generate a new one.
v0.9.0.title: The Bazaar for Archipelago v0.9.0

v0.9.1.description:
## What's new

**DeathLink goes out the moment you lose.** When your last PvP fight takes the last of your prestige, your friends hear about it right away, not when you press Continue (if the client can't read the game's memory, it still goes out on Continue).

**Received DeathLinks are a little gentler.** By default the first DeathLink you receive in a run is survived - you get a **DEATHLINK SURVIVED (1/2)** pop-up and keep playing - and the second one means conceding. Set how many it takes with `death_links_before_concede` (the Hardcore preset uses 1), and whether they all have to land in the same run with `death_links_same_run` (on by default). A DeathLink that arrives after your run is already lost doesn't count.

**Included Heroes.** Pick your heroes with one tick box each under "Included Heroes (Must own)". This replaces the old `own_<hero>` and `exclude_<hero>` switches, so tick your heroes again if your YAML used those.

**Late PvP wins and Legendary monsters are in logic.** Legendary monsters now expect the **Legendary Items** unlock, and PvP wins from day 8 expect one **Event Rarity Progression** (two from day 14). Other games will now show these as important items when their check needs them.

**Fixes**
- Closing the game in the middle of a fight no longer loses track of the run: when you continue, the client catches up on the PvP win and the day the game moved on to.
- A 10-win run now sends every check that hero has, including monsters you skipped or lost on days you played.
- Padlocks no longer disappear for the rest of the session after a run ends.
- A choice of only locked events now always lets the least rare one through.
- Generating with item links, or starting with Event Rarity Progression / Legendary Items, works again.
- Messages say "concede", not "abandon".

**Heads up:** seeds made with v0.9.0 keep working with this client and keep their own logic and DeathLink rules - only newly generated seeds get the new options.
v0.9.1.title: The Bazaar for Archipelago v0.9.1

v0.9.2.description:
## What's new

**Playing through the Tempo launcher works now.** The Tempo launcher starts The Bazaar as administrator, which stopped the client from reading the game, so locked cards got no padlocks. Now the client notices and asks Windows to restart itself as administrator. Say yes and it comes back connected to your slot.

**Created Items option.** You can now decide what happens with cards the game makes for you, like the Scrap you get from selling Temporary Shelter, or a card transformed at Mandala or by selling a Catalyst.
- **Allowed:** every created card is yours to keep, even if it's locked (the Casual preset).
- **Special Cases** (the default): only cards that are meant to be made are allowed. That's the first transform of Mak's Reagents, anything from Wink, Soda and Vending Machine drinks, and items that always spawn the same card. Everything else counts like any card you took.
- **Locked:** a created card that's still locked blocks your checks until you sell it, transform it again or use a Lock Bypass on it (the Hardcore preset).

Anything The Cult gives you is always allowed, and transforms that only last for a fight never count.

**Today's patch (1.0.12650) is in.** 19 new cards (Hydra Tree, Mecha Dragon, Dragon Harp, Treasure Map, Soda Machine and more), the new Laurel merchant and 2 new monsters, plus the starting rarity changes. The new cards have Shop Guide pictures too.

**Clearer options.** Every option now starts with a one-line summary of what it does, so hovering an option in the Options Creator tells you right away. "Max Day Check" is now called **Last Day With Checks** and "Maximum Monster Difficulty" is **Highest Monster Rarity** (your YAMLs don't need to change).

**Fixes**
- A spawned locked card in your stash no longer shows a padlock when it wasn't actually blocking anything.
- The overlay no longer loses track of a monitor on some multi-monitor setups.
- Legendary cards have a bright red-gold frame in the Shop Guide.

**Heads up:** seeds made with any 0.9 version keep working with this client. They play with created cards allowed, and the new cards and Laurel only show up in newly generated seeds.
v0.9.2.title: The Bazaar for Archipelago v0.9.2

v0.9.3.description:
## What's new

**Padlocks sit right on the cards now.** The client reads where each card actually is from the game, so a locked card's padlock sits on its art and moves with it: when you drag it, swap it, reroll the shop, or flip the stash open. Padlocks show up as soon as a new card starts turning face-up, and they only show while you can actually see the card.
- **Events** get padlocks on locked options too, including in the big view when you right-click an event.
- **Monsters:** right-click a monster on the fight-choice screen and its board shows padlocks on the locked items you could loot.
- Tooltips and enlarged cards only fade the padlocks they actually cover. The card you're hovering keeps its own padlock.

**Another player finishing can't win your seed anymore.** When someone else reached their goal, the server's auto-collect could tick checks in your world and declare your goal complete. Now your goal only counts the runs you played yourself, from any computer you play on. Your Tracker still shows checks someone collected for you as done, the way Hollow Knight does.

**The settings gear is always reachable.** When the client asks you to concede, its red notice no longer blocks the game's settings button. Put your mouse on the gear and the notice turns see-through there, so your click goes through to the game.

**Fixes**
- A run that was already open before you connected to a new seed no longer counts for that seed, and no longer gives you a concede warning unless you actually play it.
- The hero panel no longer flashes on screen when a run starts.
- Opening the stash no longer hides the whole overlay.
- Padlocks follow their cards much more smoothly.

**Heads up:** seeds made with any 0.9 version keep working with this client. Checks you sent with an older version still show as done in the Tracker, but your goal only counts heroes won with this version. If you got a hero's 10 Wins before updating, win with that hero once more for it to count toward your goal.
v0.9.3.title: The Bazaar for Archipelago v0.9.3
